_doc: HAND-labelled adjudications for attribution-suspicion candidates. Kept APART from the feature artifact (data/attribution_suspicion_2026.json) so that, once enough labels exist, weights can be fitted against frozen features without leakage -- features never absorb labels. label: confirmed_inversion | confirmed_correct | other_feed_error. basis cites the evidence that settled it. Label live_window_inversion_final_correct: the feed inverted attribution WHILE LIVE but self-corrected at final -- the final record is correct, so the final-record detector must NOT flag it; it is a positive only for live-window detection.
